profile.name: Manitou BF SA
profile.summary: Manitou BF SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacture, and distribution of equipment and services in France, Southern Europe, Northern Europe, the Americas, Asia, the Pacific, Africa, and the Middle East. The company operates in two segments: Product and Services and Solutions. It offers material handling, access, and earthmoving equipment, including rough-terrain fixed, rotating, and heavy-duty telehandlers; rough-terrain, semi-industrial, telescopic handlers, and industrial forklift trucks; wheeled or tracked skid-steer, articulated, backhoe, and track loaders; aerial work platforms; and truck-mounted forklifts, as well as warehousing equipment and accessories. The company also provides attachments, such as buckets, clamps, fork handling solutions, forks and grabs, jibs, skips, platforms, sweepers and cleaners, winches; mining solutions; earth drilling and digging solutions; snow removing and levelling solutions; and miscellaneous attachments. In addition, it offers value-added services comprising training for the dealers and key accounts, new or refurbished spare parts, after-sales service, fleet management, machine connectivity, financing solutions, maintenance and warranty extension contracts, short or long-term full-service contracts. The company sells its products through a network of dealers under the Manitou, Gehl, and Mustang by Manitou brands in agriculture, construction, industry, aeronautics, defense, environment, mining, and oil and gas markets. Manitou BF SA was incorporated in 1954 and is headquartered in Ancenis-Saint-Géréon, France.
profile.summary_fr: Manitou BF SA, avec ses filiales, se consacre au développement, à la fabrication et à la distribution d’équipements et de services en France, en Europe du Sud, en Europe du Nord, en Amérique, en Asie, dans le Pacifique, en Afrique et au Moyen-Orient. La société opère dans deux segments: Produits et Services et Solutions. Il offre du matériel de manutention, d'accès et de terrassement, y compris des chariots télescopiques fixes, rotatifs et robustes en terrain accidenté, des chariots élévateurs semi-industriels, télescopiques et des chariots élévateurs industriels; des chariots élévateurs à roues ou à chenilles, articulés, des pelleteuses et des chargeuses sur chenilles; des plates-formes de travail aériennes; des chariots élévateurs montés sur camion, ainsi que du matériel d'entreposage et des accessoires.
